question: Find the full name and date of birth of the oldest driver who was eliminated in the first qualifying period (Q1) of the 2008 Italian Grand Prix.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T3."XCL_038", T3."XCL_039", T3."XCL_040"
FROM qualifying AS T2
INNER JOIN races AS T1 ON T2."XCL_057" = T1."XCL_065"
INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_058"
WHERE T1."XCL_069" = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND T1."XCL_066" = 2008
  AND T2."XCL_063" IS NULL
ORDER BY T3."XCL_040" ASC
LIMIT 1

INNER JOIN drivers AS T3 ON T3."XCL_034" = T2."XCL_058"
WHERE T1."XCL_069" = 'Italian Grand Prix'
  AND T1."XCL_066" = 2008
  AND T2."XCL_063" IS NULL
ORDER BY T3."XCL_040" ASC
LIMIT 1
